summary: Full end-to-end testing of Tienda de Skins (backend + frontend + Stripe live checkout). 12/12 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend renders 3 sections (Destacados/Diario/Temporada) with cards, countdown, and modal. Admin tab 'Tienda Skins' renders with create form + live preview + list. Real Stripe test checkout completed successfully with card 4242 4242 4242 4242: redirect -> Stripe (Link UI) -> selected 'Card' -> filled fields -> Pay -> redirected back to /payment/success -> polling flipped state to 'Compra completada' -> PurchaseCelebration visible -> skin marked 'Adquirido' in tienda -> equip-btn worked (toast 'Ptera Tormenta equipada') -> on reopen modal shows 'Equipada' (skin-equipped-btn). WebSocket /api/shop/ws sends shop_hello and broadcasts shop_update on admin CRUD.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking equip-btn, the modal does not immediately swap the button for skin-equipped-btn; it still shows the old equip button until the modal is closed and reopened. The equip API call itself succeeds and the card refreshes correctly (toast + 'Adquirido' + 'Equipada' state on reopen). Local skin.equipped state in the modal isn't updated after successful equip.

issues: Console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Accessibility only — add a visually-hidden DialogTitle/Description.

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): In SkinDetailModal.jsx, after successful /shop/equip, refresh the local skin object (setSkin({...skin, equipped:true}) or trigger a re-fetch) so skin-equipped-btn appears without needing to reopen the modal.
OPTIONAL (a11y): Wrap DialogTitle/DialogDescription with VisuallyHidden in SkinDetailModal to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: skin_shop.py: _grant_skin returns False both when skin is missing AND when insert fails on duplicate key — makes the True/False semantics ambiguous, but the granted flag is still set which is what matters. Not a bug.

skin_shop.py stripe.error.InvalidRequestError branch on 'managed payments' fallback is guarded by string match; in test mode Stripe currently accepts managed_payments so this path isn't exercised. Works fine.
server.py includes skin_shop router with /api prefix and awaits skin_shop.ensure_indexes() on startup — wiring OK.
Frontend TiendaSkins.jsx correctly reuses shopWsUrl() and reconnects on close; WS 'shop_hello' and 'shop_update' both observed during tests.

PaymentSuccess polls every 2s with 30 tries (~60s) — sufficient; 'granted' flag both set by webhook and by /payments/status polling (idempotent). Confirmed the polling path works even without live webhook.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (only equip modal live-refresh is off; everything else works incl. real Stripe purchase)

test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo -> {token}; localStorage.setItem('primal_token', token). Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, 12/34, CVC 123, ZIP 10001. Must UNCHECK 'Save my information for faster checkout' (Link opt-in) to avoid phone-number requirement in preview.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ skins created and torn down per test run. Purchase test consumed one demo skin (Ptera Tormenta $6.99) which is now owned+equipped by the demo user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The demo/admin user already owns 'Ptera Tormenta' from this run; use a different not-owned skin for repeated purchase testing. Stripe Link UI requires (1) clicking data-testid=card-accordion-item-button via JS scrollIntoView+click, (2) filling billingAddressLine1/billingLocality/billingPostalCode/billingName, and (3) unchecking the 'Save my information' checkbox to avoid phone validation.
rca of the issue: SkinDetailModal equip refresh bug: on successful equip, the component doesn't mutate its local `skin` prop (equipped=true), and the parent TiendaSkins re-fetches skins but the modal keeps its previous `skin` prop reference until closed/reopened. Fix by either (a) locally updating displayed flag on equip success or (b) syncing `skin` from parent's refreshed list keyed by skin.id inside a useEffect.
